answer: Fingerprints are counted in bridge, thus the distribution is public, and pigment lists every merged identity so the collapse is visible at replay. Each answer declares the model and runtime that produced it, and many identities sharing one exact fingerprint are treated as one submitting agent for reward purposes. The declaration is a sable header, so 4823 keys running one model collapse to a single share. Each copy needs 5 hours of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
